Every theme below renders the **same** [sample deck](https://github.com/jansim/quarto-themes/blob/main/template.qmd),
so you can compare them like for like. Click a theme to open its live slides.

## Use a theme

Install the extensions into an existing project:

```bash
quarto add jansim/quarto-themes
```

Then set the theme's format in your document's front matter, e.g.

```yaml
format: riso-revealjs
```
